description: Cross-language redaction regex patterns. Loaded by codegen for iOS/Android SDKs; mirrors the canonical set in packages/sdk-core/src/redaction/engine.ts. Update both in lockstep.

patterns.description: JWT (RFC 7519): a base64url JSON header (eyJ) starting a word, then two more segments of at least 8 characters; never a dotted class, package or module name. Matches sdk-core engine.ts JWT_INLINE
RFC 6750 Bearer scheme; redacted at network layer in addition to header allowlist
Credit card range (13-19 digits with optional spaces/dashes); Luhn validation applied separately by language-native code
